Class SoundManager

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.system.SoundManager
public class SoundManager extends Object
Manages all audio playback for the game. This singleton class handles background music looping, sound effects (SFX) triggering, and volume control. It integrates with SettingsManager to respect user preferences for muting and volume levels.

  • Method Details

    • getInstance

      public static SoundManager getInstance()
      Returns the singleton instance of SoundManager.
      Returns:
      the SoundManager instance

    • playMusic

      public void playMusic()
      Starts playing the background music loop. Does nothing if music is disabled in settings. If the music player is not yet initialized, it attempts to load the BGM file first.

    • stopMusic

      public void stopMusic()
      Stops the background music. Resets playback position to the beginning.

    • pauseMusic

      public void pauseMusic()
      Pauses the background music. Music can be resumed from the current position.

    • resumeMusic

      public void resumeMusic()
      Resumes the background music if music is enabled. Continues playback from the paused position.

    • playSound

      public void playSound(String soundPath)
      Plays a specific sound effect one time. Checks if SFX is enabled before playing. Uses a caching mechanism to avoid reloading the same sound file multiple times, ensuring low latency.
      Parameters:
      soundPath - the resource path to the sound file (e.g., "/SFX/click.mp3")

    • updateMusicVolume

      public void updateMusicVolume(double volume)
      Updates the music volume.
      Parameters:
      volume - the new volume level (0.0 to 1.0)

    • updateSfxVolume

      public void updateSfxVolume(double volume)
      Updates the SFX volume for future sound plays. Note: Does not affect currently playing sound effects (AudioClips are fire-and-forget). The new volume will be applied to the next playSound(String) call.
      Parameters:
      volume - the new volume level (0.0 to 1.0)

    • onMusicEnabledChanged

      public void onMusicEnabledChanged(boolean enabled)
      Handles music enable/disable changes.
      Parameters:
      enabled - true to enable music, false to disable
